verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published pricing page, per-volume tier prices, overage rates, or add-on costs for dedicated IPs or validation. The only plan reference is that EU regional sending requires the 'Pro plan or above', which names a tier but gives no pricing. A community remark that costs are high above 500,000 contacts is not evidence that pricing is published.

support.subject: As a founder, I can price the service from the public site alone — per-volume tiers, overage rates, and add-on costs (dedicated IPs, validation) published without a sales call
